Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Source: `src/` (CLI `src/cli`, commands `src/commands`, provider `src/provider-web.ts`, infra `src/infra`, media `src/media`); colocated `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; plugins `extensions/*`. Installers served at `https://clawd.bot/*` live in `../clawd.bot` (`public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`). Keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Consider all built-in + extension channels when refactoring shared messaging logic. Core docs: `docs/channels/`; code: `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; plugins include `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Docs use Mintlify (`docs.clawd.bot`). Internal links in `docs/**/*.md` are root-relative, omit `.md`/`.mdx`; anchors for sections. When Peter asks for links, reply with full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs (not root-relative). When you touch docs, end the reply with the `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs you referenced. README links stay absolute. Docs content must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Node 22+; keep Node + Bun paths working. `pnpm install`; supported: `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun for TypeScript execution: `bun <file.ts>` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev CLI: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`; Node supports built output (`dist/*`) and production installs. Build/type-check `pnpm build`; lint `pnpm lint`; format `pnpm format`; tests `pnpm test`; coverage `pnpm test:coverage`. TypeScript ESM, strict typing, avoid `any`. Run `pnpm lint` before commits. Add brief comments for tricky logic; keep files concise, extract helpers, use existing CLI-option and `createDefaultDeps` patterns. Aim under ~700 LOC (~500 LOC when feasible); split/refactor for clarity/testability.

Product/app/docs headings: **Clawdbot**; CLI/package/binary/paths/config keys: `clawdbot`. Releases: stable `vYYYY.M.D` / npm `latest`; beta `vYYYY.M.D-beta.N` / npm `beta` (may omit macOS app); dev is moving `main` (no tag; `git checkout main`). Vitest/V8 thresholds: 70% lines/branches/functions/statements; tests `*.test.ts`, e2e `*.e2e.test.ts`. Run `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing logic changes. Live: `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live` or `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`; Docker: `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`; onboarding: `pnpm test:docker:onboard`; see `docs/testing.md`. Pure test additions/fixes generally do **not** need a changelog entry unless they alter user-facing behavior or the user asks for one. Before using a simulator, check for connected real devices (iOS + Android) and prefer them when available.

Commit via `scripts/committer "<msg>" <file...>`; avoid manual `git add`/`git commit` so staging stays scoped. Use concise action-oriented messages; group related changes, avoid unrelated refactors. Changelog: latest released version at top, no `Unreleased`; after publishing, bump version and start a new top section. PRs summarize scope, testing, user-facing changes/new flags.

PR review: use `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`; do **not** change branches. Prefer one `gh pr view --json ...` for metadata/comments; run `gh pr diff` only as needed. Before review of a pasted GH Issue/PR, run `git pull`; if local changes or unpushed commits exist, stop and alert the user. **Review mode (PR link only):** read `gh pr view/diff`; **do not** switch branches; **do not** change code. If given a PR link, review via `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff` and do **not** change branches.

PR merge flow: create a temp branch from `main`; merge PR branch (prefer squash unless history matters; rebase/merge when it does). Always try to merge the PR unless it’s truly difficult, then use another approach. If squashing, add PR author as co-contributor. Apply fixes, add changelog (+ PR # and thanks), run full gate before final commit, commit, merge back to `main`, delete temp branch, end on `main`. If you review then work on a PR, land via merge/squash (no direct-main commits) and always add the PR author as co-contributor. When working on a PR: add a changelog entry with PR number and thank contributor. When working on an issue: reference issue in changelog. When merging, leave a PR comment explaining exactly what we did and include SHA hashes. For a new contributor, add their avatar to README “Thanks to all clawtributors” thumbnails. After merge, run `bun scripts/update-clawtributors.ts` if contributor is missing, then commit regenerated README. **Landing mode:** create an integration branch from `main`, bring in PR commits (prefer rebase for linear history; merge allowed when complexity/conflicts make it safer), apply fixes, add changelog (+ thanks + PR #), run full gate **locally before committing** (`pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test`), commit, merge back to `main`, then `git switch main` (never stay on a topic branch after landing). Important: contributor needs to be in git graph after this! `sync`: if working tree is dirty, commit all changes (pick a sensible Conventional Commit message), then `git pull --rebase`; if rebase conflicts and cannot resolve, stop; otherwise `git push`.

Web credentials: `~/.clawdbot/credentials/`; rerun `clawdbot login` if logged out. Pi sessions default `~/.clawdbot/sessions/`; base directory is not configurable. Environment variables: `~/.profile`. Never commit or publish real phone numbers, videos, or live configuration values. Use obviously fake placeholders in docs, tests, and examples. Release work: always read `docs/reference/RELEASING.md` and `docs/platforms/mac/release.md` first; do not ask routine questions once those docs answer them. Rebrand/migration/legacy config or service warnings: run `clawdbot doctor` (see `docs/gateway/doctor.md`). “makeup” = “mac app”. Never edit `node_modules` (global/Homebrew/npm/git installs too). Skill notes go in `tools.md` or `AGENTS.md`. For GitHub Issues/PRs, print the full URL at task end. Answer only with high confidence: verify in code; do not guess.

Never update the Carbon dependency. Dependencies with `pnpm.patchedDependencies` require exact versions (no `^`/`~`). Patching dependencies (pnpm patches, overrides, or vendored changes) requires explicit approval; do not do this by default. CLI progress: use `src/cli/progress.ts` (`osc-progress` + `<REDACTED_USER>/prompts` spinner); don’t hand-roll spinners/bars. Status tables/wrapping: `src/terminal/table.ts`; `status --all` is read-only/pasteable, `status --deep` probes.

Gateway runs only as menubar app; no separate LaunchAgent/helper label. Restart via Clawdbot Mac app or `scripts/restart-mac.sh`; verify/kill with `launchctl print gui/$UID | grep clawdbot`, not a presumed label. **When debugging on macOS, start/stop the gateway via the app, not ad-hoc tmux sessions; kill any temporary tunnels before handoff.** Logs: `./scripts/clawlog.sh` (unified logs; follow/tail/category filters; passwordless sudo for `/usr/bin/log`).
